Settings.Notifications.Title: Reminders
Settings.Notifications.Lead: Clients get a text before their visit. A reminder that would fall in quiet hours waits until they are over, so nobody is woken up.
Settings.Notifications.QuietHint: No texts are sent between these times. Set both to the same time to switch quiet hours off.
Settings.Notifications.Validation.Second: The second reminder must be closer to the visit than the first.
Settings.CancellationPolicy.Title: Deposits and cancellations
Settings.CancellationPolicy.Lead: Set the deposit a booking asks for, how late a client may change or cancel a visit for free, and what a late cancellation or a missed visit costs. Clients see these rules before they book.
Settings.CancellationPolicy.FreeChangeHo: Free changes and cancellation until (hours before the visit)
0 means until the visit starts. Later than this, clients can no longer change the time online and a cancellation counts as late.
Settings.CancellationPolicy.LateFee: Late cancellation fee (% of the price)
Settings.CancellationPolicy.NoShowFeeHin: For a client who does not turn up. 0 means no fee.
Settings.CancellationPolicy.Note: Nothing is charged automatically. When a visit is missed or cancelled late, you see the fee and decide whether to add it to the client's account.
Settings.CancellationPolicy.Saved: The cancellation policy has been saved.
Settings.CancellationPolicy.Validation.P: The percentage must be between 0 and 100.
Settings.CancellationPolicy.Validation.L: A late cancellation fee needs a notice period: set the hours above 0.
Settings.CancellationPolicy.DepositHint: Asked for when a visit is booked. 0 means no deposit. A service or a client can have their own rule.
Settings.Notifications.EmailHint: Confirmations, reminders and messages about a cancelled or moved visit also go to the email address on the client card. Texts are sent either way.
Settings.SalonDetails.Title: Salon details
Settings.SalonDetails.Lead: Where clients find you and how they reach you. They see this when they book and at the end of their emails.
Settings.SalonDetails.Name: Name of the place (optional)
Settings.SalonDetails.NameHint: Only if it differs from the name of the salon.
Settings.SalonDetails.Saved: The salon details have been saved.
Settings.SalonDetails.Validation.Phone: Enter a phone number: digits, with spaces if you like, for example 020 7946 0020.
Settings.Notifications.ConfirmDeskBookin: Confirm bookings made at the desk
A client you book in by phone or in person gets the same confirmation as one who books online, with their own link to change or cancel.
Settings.Messages.Title: Messages to clients
Settings.Messages.Lead: The texts and emails your clients receive. Change the wording to sound like your salon, or keep the standard text.
Settings.Messages.When.Booking.Confirmat: Sent right after a visit is booked.
Settings.Messages.When.Booking.Reminder: Sent before the visit, at the times set under Reminders.
Settings.Messages.When.Booking.Cancelled: Sent when a visit is cancelled, by the client or by the salon.
Settings.Messages.When.Booking.Reschedul: Sent when a visit gets a new time.
Settings.Messages.When.Booking.Code: Sent when a client books online, to check the phone number.
Settings.Messages.Subject: Subject
Settings.Messages.PlaceholdersHint: Type a name exactly as shown, with the double curly brackets. It is replaced when the message is sent.
Settings.Messages.Token.ClientFirstName: the first name of the client
Settings.Messages.Token.AppointmentStart: day and time of the visit
Settings.Messages.Token.CancelUrl: the link the client uses to change or cancel the visit
Settings.Messages.Token.BookingUrl: the link to your booking page
Settings.Messages.Token.Code: the code the client types in
Settings.Messages.ResetDone: The standard wording is in use again.
Settings.Messages.PreviewUnsaved: This is a preview of what you typed. It is not saved yet.
Settings.Messages.LengthUnicode: A letter such as ą or ł, or an emoji, makes each text hold 70 characters instead of 160.
Settings.Messages.Validation.NotAllowed: This message cannot use {0}. It can use: {1}.
Settings.Messages.Validation.Required: Keep {0} in the message. Without it the message is of no use to the client.
